description: NVDA add-on for OCR, AI-powered image description, automatic recognition, and AI-assisted computer control.
changelog:
### 1.0.0

* Added fully offline text and table recognition with RapidOCR.
* Added Be My AI image descriptions and follow-up questions.
* Added OpenAI-compatible OCR, image description, and AI Agent engines.
* Added model fetching for Gemini and Gemma, and improved Kimi endpoint and model detection.
* Simplified engine names and settings.

translations.description: 为 NVDA 提供 OCR、AI 图像描述、自动识别和 AI 辅助计算机控制的插件。
translations.changelog:
### 1.0.0

* 新增 RapidOCR 离线文字及表格识别。
* 新增 Be My AI 图像描述和追问功能。
* 新增兼容 OpenAI 接口的 OCR、图像描述和 AI Agent。
* 支持获取 Gemini 和 Gemma 模型，并改进 Kimi 接口和模型识别。
* 简化引擎名称和设置。
